# One predicate on a verdict, firing on success and on error alike

An executor writing the same attribute alongside a success outcome and alongside
an error outcome is watched by one subscription: a wildcard terminal path with a
condition on the attribute value. No per-kind entry.

## The deployment

```yaml
persistence:
  driver: sqlite
  sqlite:
    path: /var/lib/rimsky/state.db
claim_producers: {}
named_locks: {}
executors:
  "verdict":
    transport: http
    endpoint: "http://verdict-service:8000"
    protocols: ["executor"]
```

The service answers `POST /v1/Execute` with either a success or an error
outcome, each carrying the same `verdict` attributes delta, chosen by the
dispatched node's type.

## The template

Four producers — success and error, each with each verdict value — and four
watchers carrying the identical subscription.

```yaml
name: uniform-delta-demo
version: "1"
nodes:
  - type: ok_red
    executor: verdict
    max_retries: 0
  - type: err_red
    executor: verdict
    max_retries: 0
  - type: ok_green
    executor: verdict
    max_retries: 0
  - type: err_green
    executor: verdict
    max_retries: 0

  - type: w_ok_red
    kind: attribute_passthrough
    subscribes:
      - node: ok_red
        type: terminal/*
        force_upstream_refresh: false
        when: 'payload.attributes_delta.verdict == "red"'
    attributes:
      schema: {type: object, properties: {saw: {type: string, default: ok_red}}}

  # w_err_red, w_ok_green and w_err_green are the same, over their own producer
```

## What the product does

The two producers whose verdict carries the watched value settle on different
terminal kinds — `terminal/success` and `terminal/error/probe/refused` — and the
one subscription form fires on both. Each watcher runs once.

The two producers carrying the other value fire nothing. All four producers ran,
so the silence is the predicate's and not a missing signal.

The erroring producer's attribute survives its error and reaches its watcher: an
author does not go blind to the verdict when the producer fails.
